description: Snowfall Climatology Toolbox is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Midwestern Regional Climate Center (MRCC). This toolbox can be used to answer questions such as: The daily snowfall observations and the daily climate normals data used in the Snowfall Climatology Toolbox were obtained from the Applied Climate Information System (ACIS). Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
